decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm's established spraying business, it likely involved meaningful engineering effort and can still be justified as a niche offering, so management would tend to continue rather than admit a premature failure.

This product is close to the core offer and was given its own webpage, indicating visible commitment and making a near-term withdrawal unlikely for a medium-sized German machinery firm with broad in-house capabilities.

Because it builds on the existing pumping and material-handling portfolio, the firm can frame early market uptake as still developing and is likely to persist with it rather than write off the launch quickly.

Fire protection flow monitoring fits the firm's future-oriented and digitalization-related direction and was presented prominently, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
